scope: Fixed-stamp changed Haskell leaf implementation; production optimization and dependency inputs unchanged. Timings use the explicit pilot adapter; owned-factory native identities and guards are checked separately.
excluded_campaigns: Initial unguarded-host paired trials contain overlapping compilers and remain provisional, not acceptance statistics.
Initial Mori seed rejection exposed /var versus /private/var README filtering; rejected fallback was not reuse.
A subsequent Mori pair requested an already-built baseline and was excluded.

measurement_protocol.resume: Only the fresh acceptance campaign was resumed; original warmup identities, source directories, locks and settings were verified; completed changed targets were not rebuilt.
measurement_protocol.idle_wait: Host compiler waiting is separate from timed Nix invocation; RSS is sampled host total, not isolated builder accounting.
measurement_protocol.fresh_seed: All acceptance copies include the same declared harmless Cabal comment, producing genuine new checkpoint recipes without deleting outputs.
limitations: Linking remains within the builder build phase; network bytes and exact isolated builder peak are uninstrumented.
No native Linux timing or default seed adoption is claimed.
Final owned-factory evaluation latency is a separate production-path gate.
